SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-05-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-05-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF MOHAMED ALI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MARRIOTT OWNERSHIP RESORTS, INC., REPRESENTED BY KEITH KOCAREK IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-05-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ALI, MOHAMED IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT MARRIOTT OWNERSHIP RESORTS, INC. PLAINTIFF MOHAMMED ALI CLAIMS DEFENDANT INCORRECTLY REPRESENTED PLAINTIFF'S INTEREST AS A REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT. PLAINTIFF HAS THE BURDEN OF PROOF TO SHOW MISREPRESENTATION. COURT FINDS THAT THE PLAINTIFF DID NOT SUSTAIN HIS BURDEN. DEFENDANT PROVIDED TO THE COURT A DOCUMENT SIGNED BY PLAINTIFF WHICH IS A REAL ESTATE MORTGAGE, WHICH SHOWN THERE WAS NO MISREPRESENTATION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
